# Code Anchors: Conformance Gate

- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the gate's producer: inline findings, the receipt as the command's only write, the contractual placement rule, the stamped record reference and full hash, the blocked-run-emits-nothing rule, and the refusal to run against an entry carrying no criteria, metrics or record.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — reads the receipt before mining anything, classifies missing / stale-code / stale-record / blocking, requires an explicit per-axis waiver, and restates the verdict in the close comment.
- `components/commands/nxs.fix.md` — writes the literal state value a fix entry's record carries in place of a verdict, so the state stays greppable and can never read as a waiver.
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.ts` — the receipt-block parser, which reads the writing release and maps an absent field to an unknown writer rather than a failure.
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.spec.ts` — pins that a receipt carrying the writer field parses to the same values as one without it.
